title: 34 The Selfie · 自拍里的身影

sents.t: Katrina Pariso had taken a photo of herself while being at home with no one else around.
sents.zh: Katrina Pariso 在家里没有别人时，给自己拍了张照片。

sents.t: She had the house to herself, or so she thought.
sents.zh: 她以为家里只有她一个人。

sents.t: It was after having taken a selfie that she realized that she wasn't alone.
sents.zh: 拍完自拍后，她才发现自己并不是一个人。

sents.t: This is the photo she took.
Now, at first glance, nothing unusual stands out, that is, until you brighten up the image and see that someone is behind her.
sents.zh: 乍一看没有什么异常，直到你把照片调亮，才看到她身后有一个人。

sents.t: Katrina swears that she was home alone when she took this, but apparently, she wasn't.
sents.zh: Katrina 发誓拍照时家里只有她一个人，但显然并不是。

sents.t: Katrina believes that a ghost had photobombed her picture, and she also thinks that this may have been her brother, who had passed away years ago.
sents.zh: Katrina 认为是有个鬼闯进了她的照片，她还觉得那可能是她多年前去世的兄弟。

sents.t: She isn't sure if that's him, though, as it appears to have long hair, which he didn't have.
sents.zh: 不过她不确定是不是他，因为照片里的人好像是长发，而他没有长发。

sents.t: She has yet to figure out what this might have been, but one thing's for sure, though: this photo has left Katrina spooked and still keeps her up at night.
sents.zh: 她还没弄清楚这到底是什么，但有一点可以肯定：这张照片把 Katrina 吓坏了，至今还让她夜里睡不着。

sents.t: Thanks for watching, and I hope you enjoyed.
